# MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0

Unmodified browser JS/CSS and LICENSE.txt from the official npm package
`maplibre-gl@5.24.0`, https://www.npmjs.com/package/maplibre-gl/v/5.24.0.
The versioned directory is the cache key. Both the shared journey template and
Studio load these local files. Keep the license when upgrading.
